source.title: Puffer Jacket Style: How to Look Sharp (Real Men Real Style)

tips.text: A puffer should fit: shoulder seams on the shoulder, sleeves to the wrist, hem around the waist; narrow baffles keep it from ballooning.
tips.why: Fit keeps a bulky jacket from looking shapeless.

tips.text: Pick puffers in charcoal, navy, olive, burgundy or matte black; skip neon and shiny finishes unless going full streetwear.
tips.why: Muted shades pair with the rest of the wardrobe.

tips.text: Balance a bulky puffer with slim or straight structured trousers and sleek shoes (Chelsea boots, minimal sneakers, lace-ups).
tips.why: A tapered lower half avoids a blocky look.

tips.text: Layer a hoodie or a turtleneck under a puffer, keeping layers flat.
Avoid an oversized puffer over baggy jeans unless you want a full streetwear silhouette.
tips.why: Volume top and bottom balloons the outline.

outfits.outfit: puffer olive casual, hoodie grey casual, jeans denim slim casual, sneakers white casual
outfits.why: Weather-ready and balanced by slim jeans.

outfits.outfit: puffer black casual, sweatshirt grey casual, joggers black slim casual, sneakers white casual
outfits.why: Tapered joggers keep an off-duty look clean.

outfits.outfit: puffer navy smart casual, sweater grey smart casual +turtleneck, trousers beige slim smart casual +chinos, boots brown smart casual +chelsea
outfits.why: Polished layers and sleek boots keep it sharp.

outfits.outfit: puffer black oversized casual, hoodie black casual, jeans denim baggy casual, sneakers white casual
outfits.why: Oversized top and baggy bottom balloon the outfit.
